title: a-change-reseals-only-its-own-components-proofs
intention: The pre-commit reseal door re-runs only the proofs of the component that owns each staged file — never the proofs of components that merely import it, and never a holder's proofs for its nested machine's change.
why: Akien answered 2026-10-05, verbatim: "tool proofs: agreed" — option 1 of "when a tool changes, should the proofs of components that use it re-run?": no, only the tool's own proofs (~/.cairn/foreground-decisions.md item 7, relayed by the peer akiendelllinux_cc_0). MEASURED: one line in liveness.py re-ran 55 proofs across 19 components (b9a7d9e5); a diagnostic.py commit reached 64 components and ran past a 30-minute limit without landing (be4a7b3c7caa, 2026-10-05). Every commit that touches a tool pays for proofs that prove other components.
how: cairn/devices/tester/reseal.py proofs_touching: compute owners = {component_of(root/s) for s in staged} - {None} once (cairn.tools.base.address.component_of, the deepest component ancestor, already in cairn/tools/base public_interface), and return each census row's proof whose component resolves into owners. The closure recipe and the directory recipe are both dropped from this door; closure_of stays imported (line 583 still reads it). One import added. The exact diff rides this ticket's build_patch field. One new proof, cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_a_change_reseals_only_its_own_components_proofs.py, already written red.
falsifier: GREEN when cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_a_change_reseals_only_its_own_components_proofs.py passes all four teeth: (1) a tester proof whose seal closure names cairn/tools/base/diagnostic.py is not returned for a staged diagnostic.py; (2) it is returned for a staged cairn/devices/tester/reseal.py under a closure seal and a pre-closure seal; (3) a cairn-device proof is not returned for a staged cairn/devices/cairn/machines/bus/bus.py; (4) on the live census every proof returned for a staged diagnostic.py belongs to cairn/tools/base; and test_reseal_door.py and test_reseal_stages_clean_seals.py stay green. RED if any fails. WRONG INTENT if a commit touching only a tool still re-runs another component's proof.

decisions.text: D1: SETTLED: apply exactly the unified diff carried in this ticket's build_patch field (`git apply` from a file holding that text, run in the cairn repo root). It edits cairn/devices/tester/reseal.py only: proofs_touching's body and docstring, and one import line `from cairn.tools.base.address import component_of`.

D2: SETTLED: the proof cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_a_change_reseals_only_its_own_components_proofs.py already stands on disk, written first as this ticket's red-first step and measured red 1/4 at HEAD 94334efb (2026-10-05: tooth 1 returned test_reseal_door.py for a staged diagnostic.py; tooth 3 returned test_cairn_device.py for a staged bus.py; tooth 4 found 64 other components reached; tooth 2 green as the guard). It is committed before the BUILDME crossing; D1 turns it green and does not edit it.

D3: SETTLED: after D1 run `python3 cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_a_change_reseals_only_its_own_components_proofs.py` (exit 0, '4 passed'), `python3 cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_reseal_door.py` and `python3 cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_reseal_stages_clean_seals.py` (each exit 0, as at HEAD). Measured so on a prototype of D1, 2026-10-05 (4/4, 9 passed, 6 passed).

D4: SETTLED: commit cairn/devices/tester/reseal.py with message '3e80b61b7acf: a change reseals only its own component's proofs' and the two trailer lines 'Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>' and 'Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01JrhBQALF5qFBEVqQJUsXUu'. No file outside cairn/devices/tester changes.

D5: SETTLED: scope. This door decides only what a commit RE-RUNS. A user's seal still records its import closure, and cairn.tools.validation_store.sealed_fingerprint_now (and so component_color) still reads a tool's change as moving that seal; whether a user's seal should stop reading its tools' changes is a different component (validation_store) and is raised with the peer akiendelllinux_cc_0, not built here (RULE 1).

D6: SETTLED: the answer that sets this behaviour is Akien answered 2026-10-05, verbatim: "tool proofs: agreed" — option 1 of "when a tool changes, should the proofs of components that use it re-run?": no, only the tool's own proofs (~/.cairn/foreground-decisions.md item 7, relayed by the peer akiendelllinux_cc_0). It is a measurement-free spec choice already answered; no question is opened.
